1º de Primaria · Inglés

My family

Ficha para imprimir
123456
1

Pregunta de arranquePiensa 30 segundos antes de seguir

Think of your family. Who lives in your house? Can you say one family word in English?

Escribe o di en voz alta tu respuesta. Después .

Maybe mum and dad, or a brother or a sister. Every family is different, and every family is special.

2

Aprende12 apartados

Para empezar: The family photo

It is Sunday. Ana is at her grandma's house. Everybody is there.

Grandpa has a camera. «Family photo!» he says.

Mum and Dad stand at the back. Ana's big brother, Pablo, is next to Dad. Ana holds the baby, her little cousin Lola.

Grandma sits on a chair in the middle. The dog sits too!

«Say cheese!» says Grandpa. Click! Ana looks at the photo and smiles. «I love my family!»

1. My family

This is my family. We live together and we love each other.

Families can be big or small. Some families have two mums or two dads. Some have one parent.

Every family is special. Who is in your family?

2. Mum and dad

This is my mum. This is my dad.

We can also say mother and father. Together they are my parents.

Mum and dad take care of me. They read me stories at night.

Vídeo: The People In My Family · Super Simple Songs (YouTube) · 23,9 millones de visualizaciones

3. Brother and sister

This is my brother. He is a boy. This is my sister. She is a girl.

A big brother is older. A little sister is younger.

Have you got a brother or a sister? Say: I have one brother. or I have no sisters.

4. Grandma and grandpa

My mum's mum is my grandma. My dad's dad is my grandpa.

We can also say granny and grandad.

Grandparents tell great stories. Do you visit your grandma and grandpa?

5. The baby

This is the baby. The baby is very small.

The baby sleeps a lot and cries a lot. The baby drinks milk.

A baby can be a baby brother or a baby sister. Shh! The baby is sleeping.

6. Who's this?

To ask about a person, we say: Who's this?

We answer: This is my sister. or This is my grandpa.

Show a photo of your family to a friend. Ask and answer!

Vídeo: Sesame Street: Family Song · Sesame Street (YouTube) · 33,8 millones de visualizaciones

7. He and she

For a boy or a man, we say he. For a girl or a woman, we say she.

This is my dad. He is tall.

This is my grandma. She is funny. He and she help us talk about people.

8. Big and small, old and young

We can describe our family with adjectives.

Dad is tall. The baby is small.

Grandpa is old. My cousin is young. My sister is happy. How is your family?

9. Uncles, aunts and cousins

Our family is bigger than our house!

Mum's brother is my uncle. Dad's sister is my aunt.

Their children are my cousins. We play together at birthday parties.

Vídeo: Family Song For Children: 7 Family Member Names · Dream English Kids (YouTube) · 8,3 millones de visualizaciones

10. I love my family

Families help each other.

We hug. We play. We eat together. We say thank you.

Say it to your family today: I love you! It is a beautiful sentence in English.

11. Game: the family tree

Draw a family tree. It looks like a real tree!

Put your grandparents at the top. Then your parents. Then you and your brothers and sisters at the bottom.

Point and say: This is my grandma. This is my mum. This is me!

12. Review: my family

Now you can name your family: mum, dad, brother, sister, grandma, grandpa and baby.

You can ask Who's this? and answer This is my…

You know he and she. And you can say I love my family! Great work!

Lo hacemos juntos · Let's do it together

Look at a photo of your mum. Your friend asks: Who's this?

  1. Point to the photo.
  2. Start with: This is my…
  3. Say: mum.

Resultado: This is my mum.

Talk about your brother. Use he.

  1. Brother is a boy.
  2. For a boy we say he.
  3. Add a word: tall, happy, funny…

Resultado: This is my brother. He is funny.

Your mum's mum is your…

  1. Mum's mum is older.
  2. She is a grandparent.

Resultado: grandma.

How many people in this family? 👨👩👧👦

  1. Count: dad, mum, sister, brother.
  2. One, two, three, four.

Resultado: Four people.

Errores típicos

  • Saying «she» for a boy: he is for boys and men, she is for girls and women.
  • Saying «my mother's» in the wrong place: «This is my mum», not «This is mum my».
  • Mixing up «grandma» and «grandpa»: grandma is a woman, grandpa is a man.
  • Saying «sister» for a brother: a sister is a girl.

Ejercicios (22)

Hazlos en tu cuaderno y después abre la solución.

Nivel básico

  1. Say: mum, dad.

    Ver solución
    Mum, dad.

  2. Draw your mum or your dad.

    Ver solución
    A drawing of a parent.

  3. Is a brother a boy or a girl?

    Ver solución
    A boy.

  4. Is a sister a boy or a girl?

    Ver solución
    A girl.

  5. Point to the baby in the picture.

    Ver solución
    The baby.

  6. Match: abuela – grandma, abuelo – grandpa.

    Ver solución
    Grandma = abuela; grandpa = abuelo.

  7. Say: I love my family.

    Ver solución
    I love my family.

  8. How many people are in your house?

    Ver solución
    Free answer, for example: four.

Nivel medio

  1. Complete: This is my ____ (papá).

    Ver solución
    dad.

  2. Answer: Who's this? (photo of a grandpa)

    Ver solución
    This is my grandpa.

  3. He or she? «This is my sister. ___ is happy.»

    Ver solución
    She.

  4. He or she? «This is my dad. ___ is tall.»

    Ver solución
    He.

  5. Draw your family and write their names.

    Ver solución
    Free answer.

  6. Complete: My mum's brother is my ____.

    Ver solución
    uncle.

  7. Say two words to describe your family: tall, small, happy, funny…

    Ver solución
    Free answer, for example: My dad is tall. My sister is funny.

  8. Do you have a brother or a sister? Answer in English.

    Ver solución
    I have one brother. / I have no sisters. (free answer)

  9. Sing a family song with a friend.

    Ver solución
    Free answer.

Nivel avanzado

  1. Make a family tree with three levels: grandparents, parents and you.

    Ver solución
    A tree with names and family words.

  2. Introduce your family: This is my… He/She is…

    Ver solución
    Free answer, for example: This is my mum. She is kind.

  3. Bring a family photo. Ask and answer «Who's this?» with a friend.

    Ver solución
    Free answer.

  4. Write a short card for someone in your family: «Dear Grandma, I love you!».

    Ver solución
    Free answer.

  5. Interview a friend: «Have you got a brother?», «Have you got a sister?».

    Ver solución
    Free answer: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.

Explícalo con tus palabrasComo si se lo contaras a alguien de un curso menor

¿Has nombrado estas ideas?
★

Situación de aprendizajeMy family book

We make a small book about our families and present it to the class in English.

Pasos

  1. At home, we choose photos or make drawings of our family.
  2. We stick one person on each page and write: This is my…
  3. We add one word for each person: tall, funny, happy, kind…
  4. We show the book to a friend. The friend asks: Who's this?

Producto final: A family mini-book with drawings and short sentences.

Cómo se valora

  • Names family members in English.
  • Uses This is my… and he / she correctly.
  • Answers the question Who's this?

Resumen visualTodo el tema en una pantalla

Glosario

Family
The people you live with and love (familia).
Mum
Your mother (mamá).
Dad
Your father (papá).
Brother
A boy with the same parents as you (hermano).
Sister
A girl with the same parents as you (hermana).
Grandma
The mother of your mum or dad (abuela).
Grandpa
The father of your mum or dad (abuelo).
Baby
A very young child (bebé).
Cousin
The child of your uncle or aunt (primo, prima).
Parents
Your mum and dad (padres).

Tarjetas de repasoToca la tarjeta para darle la vuelta

Según cómo respondas, la tarjeta vuelve mañana, en 3, en 7 o en 21 días.

Para familias

  • Mirad juntos fotos de la familia y preguntad: «Who's this?».
  • Ayudadle a dibujar el árbol familiar con los nombres en inglés.
  • Cantad la canción de la familia del tema.
  • Respetad y valorad todos los modelos de familia de la clase.

Para profesores

Saberes: Lengua extranjera (Inglés): léxico de la familia; estructuras Who's this? This is my…; pronombres he / she; adjetivos sencillos; valoración de la diversidad familiar (RD 157/2022, primer ciclo de Educación Primaria).

  • Árbol familiar con fotos o dibujos.
  • Juego de la familia de dedos (finger family).
  • Mini-libro «My family» para presentar en clase.
  • Atención a la diversidad de modelos familiares en ejemplos e imágenes.

Fuentes y revisión

  • Real Decreto 157/2022, enseñanzas mínimas de la Educación Primaria (BOE)

Revisado el 14 de noviembre de 2026.
